pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by the PEDIA Tape.
Pediatric pads should be used in children < 10 Kg or PEDIA tape color purple.

pl1: Contact patient’s LVAD coordinator as early as possible
If LVAD failure is noted and no signs of life, begin CPR procedure . Refer to appropriate COG – Defibrillator can be used as normal, shift pads to not place directly on device.
4 lead and 12 lead ECG placement and acquisition, EtCO Monitoring
Assess LVAD for function – Refer to algorithm
Assess patient for non-LVAD related illness
pl3: If a FLOW ALARM is noted, 20mL/kg Isotonic Crystalloid fluid challenge.
pl4: If FLOW ALARM still active after fluid bolus – Norepinephrine (Levophed)
